packageRules.description: Automerge Docker patch, minor, and digest updates. Critical infrastructure opts back out in a later rule.

Home Assistant's monthly release (2026.9 -> 2026.10) is a minor to Renovate but carries breaking changes, so it waits for review in its own PR. Patches (2026.9.x) keep automerging. Placed after the automerge rule so it overrides it.
Critical infrastructure: never automerge, collect every update type into one PR. Placed after the automerge rule so it overrides it, which keeps the package list in exactly one place.
willfarrell/autoheal has no maintained version tag (1.2.0 breaks the tcp:// socket proxy), so it is pinned by digest alone. Its updates come once a month and are not automerged.
immich-swipe's v4.0 image is a stray tag from 2025-12, older than v1.0, with no git tag or release behind it; following it would be a downgrade.

Docker updates wait three days, so a bad release can be pulled upstream before the deploy recreates the stack. Renovate dates only Docker Hub images; an undated one (ghcr.io, lscr.io) goes ahead without the wait instead of being held for good.

Estate images (ghcr.io/khelias/*) are pinned by their own repo's CI, which opens a pin PR here after each publish (estate ADR-008). Renovate's registry lookups lag the registry, so it would propose an older digest after CI moved the pin and automerge a silent downgrade.
